missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention (source instructions: omits coded as zero/missing; large omissions invalidate the test; not adopted)
source_note: Functional (reverse-keyed) items per the official Beck Institute DAS-A scoring table, corroborated by de Graaf et al. (2009) citing Weissman & Beck (1978): items 2/6/12/17/24/29/30/35/37/40 scored in ascending order (totally agree = 1); the remaining 30 dysfunctional items scored descending (totally agree = 7). Total = sum of all 40 (40-280); higher = more dysfunctional attitudes. The 100-item original form and Form B in the same PDF are not implemented.
